title: HackerRank Integrations | Connect Your Favorite Software
text:
Connect your favorite software to HackerRank
Integrate with your preferred solutions so you can engage, hire, and upskill the tech talent you need to innovate.
Try for free
Request a demo
Integration categories
Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)
Hire faster with ATS integrations for HackerRank Screen and Interview
Ashby
Invite candidates to HackerRank tests, view candidate scores, and access test reports from Ashby.
Avature
Send assessment invites, retrieve test reports, and view candidate scores from Avature.
BrassRing
View assessment scores, send test invites, and see interview results and notes in BrassRing.
BreezyHR
See candidate scores and status updates, access test reports and send test invites from BreezyHR.
Darwinbox
Send test invites, view candidate scores and status updates, and retrieve test reports from Darwinbox.
Freshteam
View candidate scores and status updates, send test invites, and access test reports from Freshteam.
Greenhouse
Send test invites automatically and view interview scorecards and test results in Greenhouse.
iCIMS
Schedule tech interviews, send test invites, and view interview results and test scores in iCIMS.
JazzHR
See candidate scores and status updates, send test invites, and retrieve test reports from JazzHR.
Jobvite
Review candidate scores and status updates, send test invites, and access test reports from Jobvite.
Kula
Send test invites and view test scores in Kula.
Lever
View candidate scores and feedback, send test invites, schedule interviews, and see scorecards in Lever.
LinkedIn Talent Hub
Schedule interviews, send test invites, and view interview results and test scores in LinkedIn Talent Hub.
Oracle Recruiting Cloud
Send test invites and view interview results, scorecards, test scores, and question scores in Oracle.
Recruitee
View candidate scores and status updates, send test invites, and access test reports from Recruitee.
Rippling
Retrieve test reports, review candidate scores and status updates, and send test invites from Rippling.
SAP Success Factors
Send test invites and view interview results, scorecards, test scores, and candidate feedback in SAP.
Smart Recruiters
View interview results, scorecards, and test scores and send test invites from SmartRecruiters.
Teamtailer
Retrieve test reports, send test invites, and view candidate scores and status updates from Teamtailor.
Workable
Send test invites, access test reports, and view candidate scores, status updates, and feedback from Workable.
Workday
Schedule tech interviews, send test invites, and view interviewer feedback and test scores in Workday.
Zoho Recruit
See test scores, interview results, and scorecards, schedule interviews, and send test invites in Zoho.
Scheduling
Save your hiring team time by easily scheduling and conducting tech interviews from your go-to tools.
Cisco Webex
Start a HackerRank Interview in Webex and conduct a coding or whiteboard session.
Goodtime
Schedule HackerRank interviews and generate interview links from Goodtime.
Google Calendar
Add a HackerRank interview link from the video conference dropdown in your Google calendar event.
InterviewPlanner
Generate interview links and schedule HackerRank interviews from InterviewPlanner.
Microsoft Outlook
Schedule HackerRank coding interviews and invite participants in Microsoft Outlook.
ModernLoop
Generate interview links and schedule HackerRank interviews from ModernLoop.
Prelude
Create technical interviews, including loops, in Prelude.
Talent Intelligence
Manage your talent by linking test scores to candidate profiles from your talent intelligence platform.
Eightfold
See test scores, view interview results and scorecards, schedule interviews, and send test invites from Eightfold.
Phenom People
Send test invites, view candidate scores and status updates, and access test reports from Phenom.
Prism Force
View candidate scores, retrieve test reports, and see status updates in Prism Force.
Single Sign-On (SSO)
Manage your organization by accessing secure login capabilities and enhanced user management
Azure Active Director
Configure SSO with Azure AD and give your users an easy way to login to their HackerRank accounts.
Google Workspace
Sign in easily to HackerRank with your Google Workspace account.
Okta
Login to HackerRank, and create, update, and deactivate user accounts with Okta.
OneLogin
Make it easy for your users to sign in to their HackerRank accounts with OneLogin.
SAML 2.0
Implement SSO by leveraging any IdP using SAML 2.0.
SCIM 2.0
Provision users through your SSO with SCIM 2.0.
Productivity
Enhance productivity by sending invites and viewing reports from your favorite tools.
Interview Vector
Access reports, send test invites, and view candidate scores and status updates from Interview Vector.
Slack
Generate interview links, access interview reports, and view interview results from Slack.
SplashThat
Send test invites, retrieve reports, and view candidate scores and status updates from Splash.
